description: Maps the prerequisite tree of anything you want to understand — and shows you exactly where your knowledge stops.
notes: Trees are curated by the app; marking known/unknown is self-reported.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: People bounce off hard topics because they start in the middle — the dependency-tree framing turns 'understand transformers' into a finishable path, and that's genuinely good pedagogy. $8/mo is fair; the classroom tier is the scale path. Crowded with free alternatives, but the ordered-path UX is a real differentiator.

notes.change: header brand title was invisible (dark --ink on shared dark kit header); forced light header title/sub text
dependency tree rendered at ~40% scale (shared kit caps svg height at 560px, letterboxing the tall tree); added CSS so the svg sizes to its natural aspect ratio

notes.note: Mark-known updates dependency state; zero errors. Fixed header overlap.

notes.change: Added a second topic tree (React, 14 nodes) with a topic switcher — proves the mapper generalizes beyond one course.
